titular: The night’s second kill: Rahu died on the **third attempt**, in 402 s. The first one already stopped at 92.4%. All three attempts broke the stagger (94–132 s), and the kill attempt held to the end despite 10 deaths.

recomendaciones.texto: 402 s at 213k group DPS, about 80 s more than the 01:38 kill (324 s, 264k). Deaths lowered the damage, but the group never ran out of people standing.
In the kill, 1802850 killed three players in 2 seconds (234–236 s) and caused 6 deaths over the run. That spike nearly lost the attempt: know where that zone appears and get out before it hits.

1802981 killed 3 players between 259 and 270 s of the kill, and the boss still went down. In attempt 1 the final phase came around 233 s and the attempt was lost with Rahu at 92.4%, to 1802720 at 325 s.
It came in attempts 1 (325 s) and 2 (179 s), and in neither of the night’s two kills. Consistent with it being the punishment for failing a mechanic.

Posey: 62.7k DPS (75k in attempt 2) and 2.9k support HPS: once again, the top damage dealer.
3 of your 7 deaths are from 2920718 (1802850), including the one in the 236 s spike of the kill.
Nadoriel: 1802720 killed you twice (390k taken) and 1802880 once (195k). Your first death comes at 127 s on average, earlier than in the 01:38 run (184 s).
Stalo: 48.7k DPS and a first death at 201 s on average, much better than in the previous run (129 s).
1802720 killed you twice. In the kill you went down at 383 s to 1802880, 19 s from the end: keep a defensive for the last casts.
Cry: 42.2k DPS and 5.1k HPS, no deaths before the 60-second mark and a first death at 218 s on average.
In the kill you went down at 225 s (1802750) and at 270 s (1802981). The 1802750 telegraph can be dodged: in the final phase every heal counts.
Lux: 19.7k DPS (12k in the kill): still less than half of everyone else. Reviewing rotation and gear (GS 2865) is the most urgent thing.
In the kill you died at 48 s (2920717), at 117 s (1802805) and at 234 s (2920718). Every early death takes damage away from the group.

notas.texto: This page shows only the Rahu attempts from the 02:45 run. The same run had 9 attempts on boss 2301014 (no kill, not published), and boss 2301008 died in 203 s.
Same group as the 01:38 kill: Cry, Lux, Nadoriel, Posey and Stalo.
